Quanta Services (PWR) Shareholder Neville Rodie & Shaw Increased Its Stake; Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co Has Increased Its Celgene (CELG) Stake
April 25, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Sharlyn C. Heslam increased its stake in Celgene Corp (CELG) by 24.55% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co bought 29,140 shares as the company’s stock declined 19.30% with the market. The hedge fund run by Sharlyn C. Heslam held 147,819 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $15.43 million, up from 118,679 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co who had been investing in Celgene Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $66.91B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.20% or $0.18 during the last trading session, reaching $88.96. About 2.24 million shares traded. Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) has declined 31.28% since April 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 42.83% the S&P500.
Neville Rodie & Shaw Inc increased its stake in Quanta Services Inc (PWR) by 8.62% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Neville Rodie & Shaw Inc bought 23,050 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.73% with the market. The institutional investor held 290,384 shares of the capital goods company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.36M, up from 267,334 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Neville Rodie & Shaw Inc who had been investing in Quanta Services Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $4.92B market cap company. The stock increased 0.21% or $0.07 during the last trading session, reaching $32.78. About 823,922 shares traded. Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE:PWR) has declined 5.50% since April 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.05% the S&P500.
Among 15 analysts covering Quanta Services Inc. ( NYSE:PWR ), 12 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 80% are positive. Quanta Services Inc. had 51 analyst reports since August 6, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Friday, October 2 by BB&T Capital. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Friday, July 7 by Stifel Nicolaus. The company was maintained on Thursday, October 5 by KeyBanc Capital Markets. FBR Capital maintained the shares of PWR in report on Monday, February 26 with “Buy” rating. As per Friday, January 26, the company rating was maintained by Stifel Nicolaus. As per Thursday, November 12, the company rating was downgraded by Robert W. Baird. FBR Capital maintained Quanta Services, Inc. (NYSE:PWR) rating on Monday, August 10. FBR Capital has “Outperform” rating and $29 target. The rating was maintained by Robert W. Baird with “Hold” on Wednesday, January 3. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Friday, October 6 by Stifel Nicolaus. On Monday, November 9 the stock rating was maintained by FBR Capital with “Mkt Perform”.
Neville Rodie & Shaw Inc, which manages about $1.50 billion and $948.73M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Boeing Co (NYSE:BA) by 1,932 shares to 51,298 shares, valued at $15.13M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 8,228 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 248,981 shares, and cut its stake in Nike Inc (NYSE:NKE).
Among 34 analysts covering Celgene Corporation ( NASDAQ:CELG ), 19 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 14 Hold. Therefore 56% are positive. Celgene Corporation had 142 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The company was maintained on Thursday, December 21 by Piper Jaffray. The company was upgraded on Monday, July 31 by Argus Research. The rating was downgraded by Bernstein to “Market Perform” on Wednesday, December 27. Jefferies maintained Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) rating on Thursday, September 14. Jefferies has “Buy” rating and $160.0 target. On Wednesday, August 12 the stock rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Outperform”. The rating was maintained by Cantor Fitzgerald on Monday, August 28 with “Buy”. The firm has “Buy” rating by Jefferies given on Monday, July 10. Canaccord Genuity maintained Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) rating on Friday, November 6. Canaccord Genuity has “Buy” rating and $156 target. The stock has “Equal-Weight” rating by Morgan Stanley on Friday, April 13. The rating was maintained by RBC Capital Markets with “Buy” on Wednesday, April 4.
Stock Yards Bank & Trust Co, which manages about $909.31 million US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Paychex Inc (NASDAQ:PAYX) by 4,841 shares to 256,009 shares, valued at $17.43M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Stock Yards Bancorp Inc (NASDAQ:SYBT) by 11,226 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 879,872 shares, and cut its stake in Estee Lauder Companies Inc Class (NYSE:EL).
Since February 8, 2018, it had 1 insider purchase, and 3 selling transactions for $3.58 million activity. $299,594 worth of Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) was bought by Alles Mark J. LOUGHLIN JAMES J also sold $851,093 worth of Celgene Corporation (NASDAQ:CELG) shares. 13,370 shares were sold by MARIO ERNEST, worth $1.26M on Friday, February 23.
